import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:math';

/// A simple test harness for unit tests using [unittest].
Future main() async {
  await test();
}

/// Run all the unit tests and print the results.
Future<void> test() async {
  var run = () async => runUnitTests();

  /// Runs all the unit tests, print the results and then
  /// fail the process if there are any failures.
  run().catchError((e) {
    print('There were ${e.stackTrace.length} failures.\n');
    print(e.toString());
    print('Exiting with failure.');
    exit(64);
  });

  /// Runs a single unit test, prints the results and then
  /// fails the process if there are any failures.
  runTest();
}

/// Runs a single unit test and prints the results.
Future<void> runTest() async {
  var run = () async => runTests();
  run().catchError((e) {
    print('There were ${e.stackTrace.length} failures.\n');
    print(e.toString());
    print('Exiting with failure.');
    exit(64);
  });
}

/// Runs all the unit tests in the list of tests to be run.
Future<void> runTests() async {
  // Get the list of tests to run from the arguments.
  var tests = [
    Test(function: fn0, description: 'fn0'),
  ];

  // Run each test, gather the results and print them.
  var results = await Future.wait(tests.map((test) => test.run()));
  var failures = results.where((r) => r.failures.isNotEmpty).toList();

  print('');

  if (failures.length > 0) {
    print('There were ${failures.length} failures:');
  }

  failures.forEach((f) {
    print('\nFailure for test '${f.description}':\n');
    f.failures.forEach((failure) {
      print('----');
      print('Failed expectation: ${failure.expectation}');
      print('Actual value: ${failure.actual}');
      print('Expected value: ${failure.expected}');
      print('Message: ${failure.message}');
      print('StackTrace:\n${failure.stackTrace}');
    });
  });

  if (failures.length > 0) {
    print('\nExiting with failure.');
    exit(64);
  }

  print('All tests passed.\nExiting normally.');
  exit(0);
}

/// An individual unit test with a name and a function to run to test it.
class Test {
  Test({this.description, this.function});
  final String description;
  final Function function;

  /// Runs the test and prints the result.
  Future<Result> run() async {
    var result = await function();
    if (result.failure) {
      print('Failure for test $description:');
      print('----');
      print('Failure: ${result.failure.toString()}');
      print('----');
    } else {
      print('Test $description passed!');
    }
    return result;
  }
}

/// An individual unit test result, i.e. one test either succeeded or failed.
class Result {
  Result({this.failure, this.description});
  final bool failure;
  final String description;
}
